name: Ricardo Obregón
bio:
Ricardo Obregón's career began not on the track, but behind the scenes, fueled by an early fascination with the strategic side of motorsport. He initially studied marketing and advertising, finding his niche in crafting compelling narratives around teams and drivers. His entry into the sport came through a small sponsorship deal he brokered for a local racing team, which eventually led to a full-time role. He's spent years mastering the art of maximizing sponsor visibility, crafting engaging social media campaigns, and ensuring the team's brand resonates with fans and stakeholders alike.

At Brasil Racing, Ricardo is known for his data-driven approach and his unwavering commitment to innovation. He believes in staying ahead of the curve, constantly exploring new marketing channels and strategies to reach a wider audience. Ricardo is unafraid to challenge conventional thinking and push the boundaries of what's possible in motorsport marketing. His demanding nature stems from a deep-seated desire to elevate the team's profile and drive success, both on and off the track.

What sets Ricardo apart is his deep understanding of the Latin American motorsport landscape and his ability to connect with fans on a cultural level. He understands the nuances of the regional market and uses that knowledge to create campaigns that resonate deeply. With a keen eye for detail and a relentless work ethic, Ricardo is a valuable asset to Brasil Racing.

physical.description: Ricardo is of average height and build, with a slightly weathered face that speaks to years spent working in the sun.

quirks: Insists on having a specific brand of Mexican coffee delivered to his desk every morning.
Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas and observations.
Refers to marketing campaigns as 'projects of passion'.
